CustomField.description: Rated charging power. Carries three separate legal thresholds: above 4.2 kW a non-public point is a steuerbare Verbrauchseinrichtung under BK6-22-300; at 22 kW the BNetzA register switches it from Normal- to Schnellladepunkt; and at 50 kW AFIR Art. 5 stops accepting a QR code and demands a card reader or contactless.
CustomField.label: Ladeleistung (kW)
